{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u032/system/state/workspace/programs/task-0d594af8.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Full-width and full-height lines form a regular grid of panels.
    row_cuts = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_cuts = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_cuts) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_cuts[ri] + 1, row_cuts[ri + 1]
        result_row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_cuts) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_cuts[ci] + 1, col_cuts[ci + 1]
            panel = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            # The panel background is its most frequent color; the sparse
            # foreground marks are counted, and a repeated mark is selected.
            counts = {}
            for v in panel:
                counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
            background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
            foreground_count = sum(n for v, n in counts.items() if v != background)
            result_row.append(1 if foreground_count > 1 else 0)
        out.append(result_row)
    return out
"
